## Segment summary
A man speaks to the camera while an animated graphic above him introduces and demonstrates a macOS voice assistant called "Atticus." The graphic shows the assistant opening apps, moving windows, and helping users find files, all through voice commands. The segment concludes with a demonstration of the assistant replying to an email draft.

## Segment summary
The video demonstrates a macOS application called Atticus, which learns user-defined voice commands to automate tasks. It first shows an example of replying to an email via voice, then teaches the app a "focus mode" shortcut to close Slack and open a to-do list. The segment concludes by revealing the app's requirements: it is free but requires a Claude plan (Pro or Max) or a local model, and macOS 26+.

## Events
*   `0:24.7 -` A macOS Mail application window is displayed, showing an email from "Alex Kim" and a draft reply. Below it, a voice input bar reads "Listening... Hey, reply to this." with a "DRAFT · NEVER SENDS" button.
*   `0:28.8 -` The scene transitions to a dark background. Text appears, stating "Teach it focus mode" and a "Learned shortcuts" box appears with the command "focus mode" and its actions: "close Slack" and "open to-do list," marked as "saved."
*   `0:30.2 -` The text updates to "and then" as the user says "focus mode" into the voice input bar, which now displays "NO AI · INSTANT."
*   `0:31.6 -` The text updates to "that will open" as a Reminders app window appears, showing a to-do list with items: "Finish the pitch deck," "Reply to Alex," and "Gym at 6."
*   `0:32.9 -` The text updates to "and block any" as the Slack application icon is shown with the word "closed" appearing below it.
*   `0:33.6 -` The scene transitions to a white background. Text appears, stating "The catch" and a box with a question mark icon and the text "it needs first one thing."
*   `0:35.0 -` The text updates to "The catch is your Claude" and the box changes to show a star icon and the text "it needs first your Claude plan."
*   `0:37.0 -` The text updates to "The app is free," and a yellow "FREE" button appears below the box.
*   `0:38.4 -` The text updates to "but it runs" and the "FREE" button is now positioned next to "Claude Pro" and "Max" buttons.
*   `0:39.8 -` The text updates to "or Max plan," and the "Max" button is highlighted.
*   `0:41.2 -` The text updates to "or a local model," and the "local model" option appears with "Ollama, LM Studio" written next to it.
*   `0:42.5 -` The text updates to "and it needs" and a "macOS" button appears.
*   `0:43.9 -` The text updates to "and it needs macOS 26." and the "macOS 26+" button is highlighted.
*   `0:45.3 -` The scene transitions to a comments section. The text "Want the setup?" appears above it.
*   `0:46.7 -` The user types "AT" into the comment box.
*   `0:48.0 -` The comment box shows "ATTICUS" as the user's handle, and a post button is visible.
